info.title: Vemra API
info.description: The Vemra property-rental platform. All monetary amounts are integer minor units — ₦2,500.00 is `250000` — and every amount is accompanied by its ISO 4217 currency code.

field.description: The offending input, prefixed with its location — `body.email`, `query.page`.

reason.description: Why the value was rejected, in a form safe to show a caller.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable. Clients branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable. May be reworded; do not branch on it.

requestId.description: Correlates this response with the server logs. Quote it in a support report.

value.description: The new JSON-serialized value for the setting. For money, provide a string representing integer minor units (e.g., "50000" for 500 NGN). For percentages, use a decimal string (e.g., "0.05" for 5%). For boolean toggles, use "true" or "false".

changeReason.description: Reason for the change. This is critical as it will be immutably saved in the global audit log.

grossRentProcessed.description: Total gross rent collected via payments

cautionDepositsHeld.description: Caution deposit balance held in custody liability account

referralRewardsDisbursed.description: Total referral incentives credited to tenants

totalWithdrawn.description: Total approved payouts and withdrawals paid out

pendingWithdrawalLiability.description: Total pending/recommended withdrawal requests awaiting decision

settlementAccountBalance.description: Current liquid balance in Vemra Settlement Account

name.description: Account name, e.g. "Vemra Settlement Account", "Caution Deposit Liability"

balanceMinor.description: Current computed balance in minor currency units

amountMinor.description: Entry amount in minor currency units

get.description: Reports that the process is running. Performs no I/O, so a load balancer can use it to decide whether to restart a container — a liveness probe that checked the database would restart a healthy process during a database blip.

requestId.description: Correlates this response with the server logs.

get.description: Reports whether this instance can serve traffic, checking every dependency: PostgreSQL, Redis, and that every required platform setting has an active version. All checks run before responding, so the body names each failure rather than only the first.

200.description: Every dependency is reachable and the platform is configured.

checks.description: The names of the checks that passed.

requestId.description: Correlates this response with the server logs.

503.description: At least one check failed. `details` names each failing check and why. The instance is not broken, it is not yet able to serve — a load balancer reads this as "try another instance".

get.description: Not a real endpoint. It documents the shape of the 404 every unmatched path returns, and the requested path is deliberately not reflected back in the body.

post.summary: Workflow Step 1: Get signed upload policy
post.description:
Step 1 of the KYC workflow. The frontend must request an upload policy grant for each document the user (Tenant or Landlord) wants to upload. This returns a signed policy and a Cloudinary endpoint. The frontend uses the `url` and `fields` from this response to POST the actual file directly to Cloudinary. Do not send the file bytes to this Vemra backend.

**🔑 Authentication Required** (Any Role)

fileName.description: Name of the file with extension (e.g. passport.jpg, id_card.pdf)

contentType.description: MIME type of document. Supported document formats: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf. Videos are not permitted for KYC.

maxSizeBytes.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes (up to 10MB)

requestId.description: Correlates this response with the server logs.

post.summary: Workflow Step 2: Submit KYC for review
post.description:
Step 2 of the KYC workflow. Once the frontend successfully uploads the documents to Cloudinary using the grant from Step 1, submit the KYC application here. Pass the Cloudinary `storagePath` along with any text claims (e.g. NIN, CAC registration for landlords).

**🔑 Authentication Required** (Any Role)

checkType.description: Type of document, e.g. IDENTITY or PROOF_OF_ADDRESS

storagePath.description: Cloudinary storage path of uploaded document

requestId.description: Correlates this response with the server logs.
